explication: Rust’s repository contains the Rust compiler, standard library, documentation generator, and developer tools. The principal workflow is a developer submitting Rust source to rustc and receiving compiled output; the compiler’s tree also shows distinct parsing, lowering, type-checking, borrow-checking, and code-generation stages. The sampled files establish links within inference and trait solving, but do not expose the compiler’s top-level orchestration, so those broader workflow links are marked unverified. README capabilities such as rustdoc, rustfmt, Clippy, and rust-analyzer are included as product branches.
